title: Effective Bialynicki-Birula-Brosnan motivic decompositions
summary: Let $G$ be an isotropic reductive group and $X$ be a projective $G$-homogeneous variety. Using results from Bialynicki-Birula, Hesselink and Iversen, Brosnan showed that if $G$ is of inner type, the motive of $X$ can be expressed as a direct sum of Tate twists of motives of projective homogeneous varieties for the anisotropic kernel of $G$. We provide a SageMath implementation of this decomposition, based on a depth-first search of the Cayley graph of the Weyl group of $G$, ensuring the complexity scales with the size of the motive rather than the full Weyl group.
